bic_trace_step.reason: In the function `q6apm_lpass_dai_prepare`, when `substream->stream == SNDRV_PCM_STREAM_PLAYBACK`, the code unconditionally calls `q6apm_graph_open` and overwrites `dai_data->graph[graph_id]` without checking if a graph has already been allocated (lines 127-135). If the prepare callback is called multiple times, this leads to redundant graph allocations and memory leaks.
